diagnostics.message: bidirectional control character U+202E is not allowed outside string literals
diagnostics.label: invisible character that reorders how the text displays
diagnostics.help: remove it; bidi controls may only appear inside string literals (Trojan Source, CVE-2021-42574)

diagnostics.message: unit suffix `ms` is not allowed on a binary literal
diagnostics.help: write the value in decimal, or convert it with T(x), where T is the unit type

diagnostics.message: `\u{D800}` is not a Unicode scalar value
diagnostics.help: use a scalar value in U+0000–U+D7FF or U+E000–U+10FFFF
